name: Zucchini Noodles with Sausage, Spinach & Parmesan-Lemon Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Arrange sausages on the baking sheet and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated); roast, flipping once, until sausages are golden and cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
6 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a plate.
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the plate with the parsley (keeping them separate); set aside.
Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles; place in a large bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large pot.
Juice lemons into the pot with the garlic.
Mince pine nuts and add to the pot along with broth, oil, and spices; set over medium-high heat and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup pine nuts
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid in the pot comes to a simmer, add zucchini noodles and cook, stirring often, until just tender, about 4 minutes.
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add parsley and half of the Parmesan (reserve remaining cheese for serving) to the pot; stir to combine and remove from heat.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into rounds.
To serve, divide saucy zucchini noodles and sausage between bowls; top with remaining Parmesan and enjoy!
